articles.title: Floodwater Enters Houses in Dildarpur Village - Prokerala
articles.full_text:
Bhagalpur: A person lies on a cot surrounded by floodwater inside his home as a woman sits nearby amid the worsening flood situation in Patna and several other districts of Bihar, in Bhagalpur, Bihar, on Thursday, August 27, 2026.
Residents wade through knee-deep floodwater to reach their homes after floodwaters entered Dildarpur village in Bhagalpur, Bihar, on Thursday, August 27, 2026.
A person wades through knee-deep floodwater after it entered a university campus in the Professor Colony in Bhagalpur, Bihar, on Thursday, August 27, 2026.
